required: Exact Buffer organization and X channel/brand identity with current access
respondent_or_source: Retained public identities are candidates; current registry/readback
validation: Verify exact organization/channel/account rather than first service; no unrelated identities

required: Supported credential provisioning and explicit current publication grant
respondent_or_source: Existing owner-controlled secure facility/qualified platform requirements
validation: Reuse routine owner grant where sufficient; satisfy actual provider/owner verification steps, never emit credential values

required: Current supported API schema/media capability, allowed route, platform entitlement and zero-cash limits
respondent_or_source: Official Buffer/X documentation plus account capability readback
independent_work: Prepared reviewed piece and fixture receipts
validation: Validate exact fields/action scopes and receiving account; no paid plan or unsupported browser automation

required: Primary factual sources, asset rights/provenance and attributable independent editorial review
respondent_or_source: Public sources/retained assets and assigned reviewer
independent_work: Research sourced candidate and recompute math
validation: Every claim and asset hash review passes before publication; queue does not supply scientific evidence

required: Allowed metrics route, fresh baseline, coverage and experiment window
respondent_or_source: Account analytics/API or authenticated export owner
blocked_effect: Audience evaluation claiming real measured result
independent_work: Fixture analysis, predeclared metric contract and future content research
validation: Timestamp exact account/content/window; unavailable metrics stay unknown and may require alternative measurable experiment

required: Native Jira matching/admission and exclusive release/scheduler owner
blocked_effect: Unregistered experiment effects or conflicting workflow edits
validation: Preserve BOTS-29 25m actuals and other historical estimates; native scope/source readback before effects

required: X written explicit approval/consent for optional AI automated replies
respondent_or_source: Platform approval if this tactic is selected
independent_work: Original permitted posting, correction drafts, engagement reading
validation: Verify platform evidence; do not treat existing owner account authority as X reply approval

required: Finite approved model/tool budget and zero monetary spend rule
independent_work: Deterministic validation and cheap idle scheduling
validation: Reserve cost/token limits before call and block unavailable/paid fallback; record actual usage

required: Qualified R730 target and recorded fenced operator cutover
independent_work: Independent Windows runtime and isolated backup restore
validation: Demonstrate old owner fenced, receipt reconciliation, target-local credential refs and rollback
